_note: Runwae Apparel shop (developer handoff 2026-10-14). Shown now: one focus piece (pre-order), The Little Things next drop, the Drawn Series as concepts (AI concept photography of the owner's drawings on garments, captioned Concept; bare sketches are not featured, Principal 2026-10-14). Archive: real Fall '21 pieces only. Poison and Pave hoodies are removed for good. images[].file: an assets/manifest.json key, or a pre-seed file name. source_images: originals under ../design for tools/assets.py. Principal 2026-10-14: True Grit Tee, Crafting Tee, The Little Things Tee, Luv Thy Neighbor Tee and RWA Sweatpants removed (future sweatpants get a new design); Faces Tee is a maybe (in_development). Runwae Apparel Tee stays front-only: the FB2 back is third-party art (#82-d). Principal 2026-10-14 adds from the concept boards: Essentials (Sketch, Chest-Drawing, Runwae Company hoodies, Knit Polo, Field Jacket) and Drawn Series shirts (Garden, Rust Corduroy). Board logos and prices are not used. RWA Tee removed (Principal). The Runwae Company Tee added from a_clean_editorial_product_catalog_style_layout_i. Reissues (Principal 2026-10-14): Runwae Apparel Hoodie, TRC Hoodie, The Runwae Company Hoodie in the cohesive palette; original 2021 photos shown as 'Original 2021' (preview only, people listed in images.json _people). v4 (2026-10-14): The Drawn Series capsule of seven (Foundation Hoodie = Runwae Apparel + Sketch hoodies; Atelier Shirt = Botanical Button-Down; Field Overshirt = Field Jacket; Figure Overshirt; new Globe Hoodie, Sketch Tee, Botanical Tee). Other concepts sit behind the capsule as Next drop / Essentials / The Little Things / Archive. The owner's bare drawings (art-*) appear only as art panels on the Drawn Series page (Principal 2026-10-14). Focus item stays the Luv Thy Neighbor Hoodie: a real, finished design with its own artwork, while the capsule is concept renders with fabric and print still open. Concept prices are ignored.
